title: West Damar language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Maluku, Indonesia
extract: West Damar, or North Damar, is an Austronesian language of Damar Island, one of the Maluku Islands of Indonesia. In spite of rather low cognacy rates with its neighboring languages, it can be classified as part of the Babar languages based on shared innovations.
